text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urgh… My stomach's full of butterflies…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Do you think I'll do well today? Do you think we trained enough?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What if I can't be as cool as I want? Or worse, what if I start think'n it'd be fine to lose again…
choice_data_list: You'll be fine. Hard work always pays off.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're right, Trainer. I've done everything I was s'posed to. It'll all work out!
choice_data_list: Show them how much you've improved!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll leave their jaws on the floor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I may have been able to cheer her up, but the truth is, I don't know what's going to happen. What happens next depends on how she does today.
choice_data_list: (But still… I just hope she gives it her all.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, take a look at the crowd. Are those all Yukino Bijin fans?

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: I think so. It looks like they're holding plushies of her. There's even more of them than back at the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Man… how big is she going to get? This is getting nuts.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Still… all this does is make me wanna cheer for Harp Alpha even harder!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans
text_block_list.text: SQUEEE! It's Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Th-there's so many of you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Have I always had this many fans? Why are so many people cheer'n for me after I lost?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can win today, Yukino! We're cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-right. Thanks ood—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: If you don't win, we won't be able to see you standing center stage at the concert!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: Sing a cute song today! I'll be in the front row waving my lightstick!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's why you want me to win?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Doesn't anybody actually want t'see me race?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I've got all these people cheer'n for me, but… do they b'lieve in me?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Stop that. Even if nobody else does, Trainer b'lieves in me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So either way, I just gotta run!
